title: scene.json
description: The Map's nodes, Helpers left out, in walk order: a node's id is its position in the list, and its parent comes before it.

wind_zone.description: A Unity WindZone on this node: directional ones blow along the node's local +Z converted to Blender's space, spherical ones out from it within radius.

sky.description: Part of a Sky Dome's clouds or stars: shown only in the Map Variants whose Sky lists it, and never a Candidate. Every descendant of a sky node is one too.

winds.description: The SpeedTree wind settings renderers name by index: each tree's SpeedTreeWindAsset, once per distinct one.

floats.description: The asset's numbers by their Raw Property names (m_sParams and its own fields).

flags.description: The names of its switches that are on, sorted.

draws.description: What the renderer draws, in the game's order: each a submesh of its mesh with a material. A submesh that appears twice is drawn again with another material, as a second pass.

shadows.description: How the renderer casts shadows, Unity's ShadowCastingMode: off, on (from the faces its material draws), two_sided, or shadows_only (casts but isn't drawn).

realtime_gi.description: Whether the game adds real-time GI to the renderer (Enlighten, m_LightmapIndexDynamic): light bounced at run time that no file holds, which the Builder approximates (ADR 0025).

reflection_probes.description: How the renderer takes reflection probes, Unity's ReflectionProbeUsage: off (the Map's own reflection only), blend_probes, blend_probes_and_skybox, or simple (ADR 0026).

wind.description: The index in scene.json's winds of the SpeedTree wind its tree moves with.

layer.description: Its GameObject's Unity layer. A light lights it only if this layer is in the light's culling_mask.
